title: The Montparnasse Algorithm for RNA Design
abstract: arXiv:2606.07562v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Inverse RNA Folding consists of finding a nucleotide sequence that folds into a predefined secondary structure. It is useful for synthetic biology, medicine, and nanotechnology. We propose Montparnasse, a Monte Carlo search framework based on Generalized Nested Rollout Policy Adaptation, augmented with a structural prior derived from the energy model, slow and long adaptation at level 1, a lexicographic multicriteria evaluation, a local repair of the pairs the predicted folding gets wrong, and a fleet of parallel workers coupled through a shared beam whose diversity is maintained on the faults the candidates make rather than on the candidates themselves. On the Eterna100 V1 benchmark, with both solvers folding through the same ViennaRNA 1.8.5 library under the Turner 1999 model, with 100 parallel workers and a budget of 30 minutes per puzzle, Montparnasse solves a median of 96 of the 100 puzzles against a median of 90 for DesiR

translated_abstract: 逆RNA折叠问题是指找到一个能够折叠成预定二级结构的核苷酸序列，其在合成生物学、医学和纳米技术领域具有重要应用价值。我们提出了Montparnasse，一个基于广义嵌套rollout策略自适应的蒙特卡洛搜索框架，并通过以下多项技术加以增强：从能量模型导出的结构先验、第1层的慢速长时自适应、字典序多准则评估、对预测折叠中错误碱基对的局部修复机制，以及一组通过共享beam耦合的并行工作进程——其多样性是基于候选者所犯的错误而非候选者本身来维持的。在Eterna100 V1基准测试中，两个求解器均通过相同的ViennaRNA 1.8.5库在Turner 1999能量模型下进行折叠预测，在100个并行工作进程且每个谜题预算30分钟的条件下，Montparnasse在100个谜题中解决数量的中位数为96个，而DesiR的解决数量中位数为90个。
tldr: Montparnasse是一种基于广义嵌套rollout策略自适应的蒙特卡洛逆RNA折叠搜索算法，通过结构先验、字典序多准则评估、错误碱基对局部修复以及基于错误维持多样性的并行搜索等创新，在Eterna100基准上中位数解决了100个谜题中的96个，超越了DesiR的90个。
en_tdlr: Montparnasse is a Monte Carlo inverse RNA folding search framework based on Generalized Nested Rollout Policy Adaptation, combining structural priors from the energy model, lexicographic multicriteria evaluation, local repair of mispredicted base pairs, and parallel workers maintaining diversity on candidate faults, solving a median of 96 of 100 puzzles on the Eterna100 benchmark versus 90 for DesiR.
